messages:
nina (people-ops): Heads-up — we have an unannounced visitor (Sasha Lee) coming at 2:30 with a bulky sneaker display box. Front desk doesn't see her on the calendar. Need a temp badge + a couch near the lounge for ~45m.
frontdesk-bot: Visitor check-in ping: Sasha Lee (Acme Footwear) arriving 14:30, 1 guest, 1 crate marked 'Fragile'. Notify host or badge will be 'VIS-Temp'.
kevin.t: that's prob the Acme partner I met last week — I asked them to stop by today. I can pop down in 10 to meet them and sign for the crate.
maria.g: @kevin.t can you confirm name spelling? Front desk wants exact match for badge.
kevin.t: confirmed — Sasha Lee (spelled L-E-E). I'll be there at 14:35. :thumbsup:
liz: also — mail incoming: there's a small courier with a shoebox that looks like a prototype. Please instruct them to leave it with reception; I'll tag it to kevin.t.
amy: couch dibs? I was going to use the lounge but can move. If we need a quieter spot, the meeting room A is free from 3pm.
nina (people-ops): nice — we'll reserve the couch for guest seating until 3pm and then move to MRA if they stay. Front desk, please print a temp visitor badge and note 'Acme Partner — Kevin T host'.
frontdesk-bot: Badge printed: VIS-Temp #342, pinned to Sasha Lee. Crate logged in deliveries.json with note 'prototype — fragile'.
maria.g: can we label the prototype box 'studio' and put in locker B2? fewer curious hands. Locker B2 code: `8421` (front desk only).
frontdesk-bot: Crate placed in Locker B2. Access log: kevin.t (pickup at 14:37).
kevin.t: grabbed it, looks intact. Sasha here now, heading to lounge. Thanks team! :wave:
liz: thanks for the heads up — dropping an FYI in calendar to add 'Acme walk-in' so front desk has a record.
amy: also — quick poll: does anyone want the leftover donuts in kitchen? (1) yes, (2) no (I will take them if nobody answers). :doughnut:
maria.g: (1) absolutely.
nina (people-ops): closing thread — all set. If anything else comes up ping #people-ops.
